assistance_review_consistent.name: assistance_review_consistent
assistance_review_consistent.value: ("assistance_requests"."status" = 'requested' AND "assistance_requests"."reviewed_at" IS NULL AND "assistance_requests"."reviewed_by" IS NULL) OR ("assistance_requests"."status" <> 'requested' AND "assistance_requests"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "assistance_requests"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL)

email_outbox_one_subject.name: email_outbox_one_subject
email_outbox_one_subject.value:
(
    ("email_outbox"."registration_id" IS NOT NULL)::integer +
    ("email_outbox"."settlement_reminder_id" IS NOT NULL)::integer = 1
  )

approved_mp_evidence.name: approved_mp_evidence
approved_mp_evidence.value:
"payment_attempts"."source" <> 'mercado_pago' OR "payment_attempts"."status" <> 'approved' OR (
    "payment_attempts"."provider_order_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_attempts"."external_reference" IS NOT NULL
    AND "payment_attempts"."provider_status" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_attempts"."provider_status_detail" IS NOT NULL
    AND "payment_attempts"."provider_status" = 'processed' AND "payment_attempts"."provider_status_detail" = 'accredited'
    AND "payment_attempts"."provider_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_attempts"."provider_application_id" IS NOT NULL
    AND "payment_attempts"."provider_live_mode" IS NOT NULL
    AND "payment_attempts"."reconciled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_attempts"."paid_amount_minor" >= "payment_attempts"."amount_minor"
  )

approved_manual_evidence.name: approved_manual_evidence
approved_manual_evidence.value:
"payment_attempts"."source" = 'mercado_pago' OR "payment_attempts"."status" <> 'approved' OR (
    "payment_attempts"."manual_verified_by" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_attempts"."manual_verified_at" IS NOT NULL
    AND "payment_attempts"."paid_amount_minor" >= "payment_attempts"."amount_minor"
  )

promotion_valid_window.name: promotion_valid_window
promotion_valid_window.value: "workshop_promotions"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "workshop_promotions"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "workshop_promotions"."starts_at" < "workshop_promotions"."ends_at"

promotion_valid_shape.name: promotion_valid_shape
promotion_valid_shape.value:
(
    "workshop_promotions"."kind" = 'bundle' AND "workshop_promotions"."bundle_size" IS NOT NULL AND "workshop_promotions"."payable_people" IS NOT NULL
      AND "workshop_promotions"."bundle_size" >= 2 AND "workshop_promotions"."payable_people" >= 1
      AND "workshop_promotions"."payable_people" < "workshop_promotions"."bundle_size"
      AND "workshop_promotions"."min_people" IS NULL AND "workshop_promotions"."max_people" IS NULL AND "workshop_promotions"."group_total_minor" IS NULL
  ) OR (
    "workshop_promotions"."kind" = 'group_fixed' AND "workshop_promotions"."bundle_size" IS NULL AND "workshop_promotions"."payable_people" IS NULL
      AND "workshop_promotions"."min_people" IS NOT NULL AND "workshop_promotions"."max_people" IS NOT NULL AND "workshop_promotions"."group_total_minor" IS NOT NULL
      AND "workshop_promotions"."min_people" >= 2 AND "workshop_promotions"."max_people" >= "workshop_promotions"."min_people"
      AND "workshop_promotions"."group_total_minor" > 0
  )
